faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPKV Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the MPKV Assistant Professor recruitment is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Assistant Professor post in the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV) recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 45,000/- per month for candidates with NET/SLET/SET and experience, and Rs. 25,000/- per month for Master's degree holders without NET/SLET/SET.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph. D. or Master's Degree in the relevant field/subject along with NET/SLET/SET. Two years of experience in Research/Teaching/Extension Education and published papers are also required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 500/- for all categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview by a Selection Committee approved by the University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual, for a period of 11 months.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Dhule, Maharashtra, at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ACD/EST/Notification/Contract AP/2768/2026.
